question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(f.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name

ranked AS (
    SELECT

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十

    SELECT 
        p.brand,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS brand_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
WITH outlet_avg AS (
    SELECT outlet_id, SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
    GROUP BY outlet_id
),

    SELECT AVG(total_net) AS avg_net
    FROM outlet_avg
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS outlet_count
FROM outlet_avg
WHERE total_net > (SELECT avg_net FROM overall_avg)

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        d.month,
        SUM(f.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month IN (7, 8)
    GROUP BY p.category, d.month
)

    a.category
FROM monthly_sales a

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_sales_combos
FROM rel_outlet_sku ros
LEFT JOIN fact_sales fs
  ON ros.outlet_id = fs.outlet_id
 AND ros.sku_id = fs.sku_id
 AND fs.date_key IN (
   SELECT date_key FROM dim_date WHERE year_month = '2026-08'
 )
WHERE fs.outlet_id IS NULL
  AND (ros.delisted_date IS NULL OR ros.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
  AND (ros.listed_date IS NULL OR ros.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31')

question: 2026年8月新品销额占各大区总销额的比例

    JOIN dim_outlet o ON fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON fs.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8
      AND p.is_new_product = TRUE

total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) AS total_amount

    JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8

)

    t.region,
    COALESCE(n.new_product_amount, 0) / NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0) AS new_product_ratio
FROM total_sales t
LEFT JOIN new_product_sales n ON t.region = n.region
ORDER BY t.region

question: 2026年各月活跃终端数及相比上月的变化

WITH monthly_active AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.full_date) AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fs.outlet_id) AS active_outlets
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.full_date)
)
SELECT
    STRFTIME(month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    active_outlets,
    active_outlets - LAG(active_outlets) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM monthly_active
ORDER BY month

question: 2026年8月各大区的费效比是多少
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    d.region,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) AS sales_amt,
    SUM(fpc.cost_amount) AS promo_cost
  FROM fact_sales fs
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet d ON fs.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost fpc 
    ON fs.date_key = fpc.date_key 
    AND fs.outlet_id = fpc.outlet_id 
    AND fs.sku_id = fpc.sku_id 
    AND fs.dealer_id = fpc.dealer_id
  WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8
  GROUP BY d.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  CASE WHEN sales_amt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE promo_cost / sales_amt END AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM monthly
ORDER BY region

question: 2026年8月碳酸饮料的动销率是多少
sql:
WITH sku_list AS (
    SELECT sku_id
    FROM dim_product
    WHERE category = '碳酸饮料'
),
listed_outlets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT outlet_id, sku_id
    FROM rel_outlet_sku
    WHERE sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sku_list)
      AND listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND (delisted_date IS NULL OR delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
),
sales_outlets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fs.outlet_id, fs.sku_id
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8
      AND fs.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sku_list)
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sales_outlets.outlet_id || '-' || sales_outlets.sku_id)::DECIMAL / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT listed_outlets.outlet_id || '-' || listed_outlets.sku_id), 0) AS 动销率
FROM listed_outlets
LEFT JOIN sales_outlets 
    ON listed_outlets.outlet_id = sales_outlets.outlet_id 
    AND listed_outlets.sku_id = sales_outlets.sku_id

question: 各大区的拜访达成率是多少

WITH visit_plan AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT vp.rep_id || '-' || vp.outlet_id || '-' || vp.date_key) AS planned_visits
    FROM fact_visit_plan vp
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON vp.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    GROUP BY o.region
),
visit_exec AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fv.rep_id || '-' || fv.outlet_id || '-' || fv.date_key) AS executed_visits
    FROM fact_visit fv
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON fv.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE fv.is_executed = TRUE
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    vp.region,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ve.executed_visits, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(vp.planned_visits, 0), 4) AS visit_achievement_rate
FROM visit_plan vp
LEFT JOIN visit_exec ve ON vp.region = ve.region
ORDER BY vp.region

question: 2026年8月的库存周转天数是多少
sql:
WITH inv AS (
    SELECT 
        dealer_id,
        sku_id,
        SUM(qty_on_hand) AS avg_inventory
    FROM fact_inventory
    WHERE date_key IN (
        SELECT date_key FROM dim_date WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 8
    )
    GROUP BY dealer_id, sku_id
),
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        dealer_id,
        sku_id,
        SUM(qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE date_key IN (
        SELECT date_key FROM dim_date WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 8
    )
    GROUP BY dealer_id, sku_id
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(s.total_qty) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE SUM(i.avg_inventory) * 31.0 / SUM(s.total_qty) 
    END AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM inv i
LEFT JOIN sales s ON i.dealer_id = s.dealer_id AND i.sku_id = s.sku_id

WITH new_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sku_id
    FROM dim_product
    WHERE is_new_product = TRUE
),
outlet_sku_listed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.region, o.outlet_id, r.sku_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id
    WHERE r.delisted_date IS NULL OR r.delisted_date > CURRENT_DATE
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.outlet_id END) AS new_product_outlets,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id) AS total_outlets
    FROM dim_outlet o
    LEFT JOIN outlet_sku_listed osl ON o.outlet_id = osl.outlet_id
    LEFT JOIN new_products n ON osl.sku_id = n.sku_id
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND(new_product_outlets * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_outlets, 0) * 100, 2) AS new_product_coverage_rate
FROM region_stats
WHERE total_outlets > 0
ORDER BY region

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS current_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY o.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS previous_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS region,
    (c.current_sales - p.previous_sales) / NULLIF(p.previous_sales, 0) AS growth_rate
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
WHERE c.current_sales IS NOT NULL OR p.previous_sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY region

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.outlet_id) AS current_output
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.outlet_id) AS last_year_output
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
    c.current_output - l.last_year_output AS output_change
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN last_year_period l ON c.channel = l.channel

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH half_year_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.month BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN '2025H2'
            WHEN d.year = 2026 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) AS sales,
        SUM(fpc.cost_amount) AS promo_cost
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost fpc ON fs.date_key = fpc.date_key 
        AND fs.outlet_id = fpc.outlet_id 
        AND fs.sku_id = fpc.sku_id 
        AND fs.dealer_id = fpc.dealer_id
    WHERE (d.year = 2025 AND d.month BETWEEN 7 AND 12)
       OR (d.year = 2026 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) FROM half_year_metrics WHERE period = '2026H1') -
    (SELECT promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) FROM half_year_metrics WHERE period = '2025H2') AS cost_effectiveness_diff
